newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria slows petrol imports - agency.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria slows petrol imports - agency.

text.p: Nigeria has slowed its importation of petroleum products, the national news agency reported on Friday.

The News Agency of Nigeria said port statistics showed that one vessel carrying 28,420 tonnes of petrol was expected to berth in Lagos by Tuesday, while another with 27,579 tonnes was also waiting to berth.
"The figure is a marked decrease from previous weeks when the number of tankers declared at the port was much higher," the agency said. It did not give figures for previous weeks.
Nigeria pumps over two million barrels of crude oil per day, but its four refineries are plagued by technical problems, limiting their output far below their capacity of 445,000 bpd.
As a result Nigeria has been importing petrol to minimise shortages.
